sentences.text:
Magistrate vs In Re : Shri Kumar Gaurav on 10 April, 2024
 10.04.2024
 46
 S.D./A.D.
 Allowed
 C.R.M. (A) No. 1192 of 2024

In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under S  438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with A  Women Police Station Kharagpur being Case No. 124 of 2023  dated 28.11.2023 under Sections 498A/323/509/34 of the Ind  Penal Code read with Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition   pending before the Court of learned Additional Chief Judic  Magistrate, Kharagpur, Paschim Medinipur.
 And  In Re : Shri Kumar Gaurav  ..... petitioner  Mr. Kusal Kumar Mukherjee  Ms. Suchismita Dutta  .....for the petitioner  Mr. Iqbal Kabir  Mr. S.S. Saha  ....for the State  Mr. Soumyajit Das Mahapatra  Ms. Madhurai Sinha  ...for the de facto complainant  1.
Petitioner submits there was a matrimonial dispute and he has been falsely implicated.

2. Learned Lawyer for the State submits petitioner did not respond to the notice under Section 41A Cr.P.C.
3.
Learned Lawyer for the de facto complainant submits stridhan articles have not been recovered.
4. We have considered the materials on record.
Allegations of torture are general and omnibus.
There is no medical report supporting the allegation of physical assault.

With regard to recovery of stridhan articles, we are of the opinion custodial interrogation is not necessary but the Signed By :
Surojit Das High Court of Calcutta 15 th of April 2024 12:29:32 AM petitioner is required to cooperate with the investigating agency in accordance with law.

entities.text: Surojit Das High Court of Calcutta
entities.label: JUDGE

sentences.text:
Magistrate vs In Re : Shri Kumar Gaurav on 10 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/180745864/
1 5.

Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest the petitioner shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/-, with two sureties of like amount each, to the satisfaction of the arresting officer and also be subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 and on condition he shall meet the Investigating Officer once in a week and co-operate with the Investigating Agency for recovery stridhan articles, if any.
He shall appear before the jurisdictional Court and pray for regular bail within a period of four weeks from date.
6. The application for anticipatory bail is, thus, allowed.

(Gaurang Kanth, J.) (Joymalya Bagchi, J.) Signed By :
Surojit Das High Court of Calcutta 15 th of April 2024 12:29:32 AM Magistrate vs In Re : Shri Kumar Gaurav on 10 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/180745864/
